meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码库、命令或改动拆成一步步图解,讲给完全不懂的人听
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里有人不是工程师,却需要快速弄懂某段代码或某次改动。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if someone on your team must grasp code without being an engineer.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把代码库、文件夹、功能、命令或 PR 解释给完全不懂的人：先写出一句话答案，再生成 PR Lens 画布，画面从两个方框逐步长大，最后给出链接，读者打开按播放即可。
howto.when: 当你输入 /eli5 <事物>，或要求把代码解释给新手、新员工、非工程师等完全不懂的人时触发。

say.note: 生成逐步展开的画布并给出查看链接

say.text: /eli5 帮我解释这个功能，讲给新来的同事听
say.note: 先写一句答案，再逐步搭出全貌

say.text: /eli5 像讲给五岁小孩一样解释这个命令
say.note: 最后回复一句答案加链接，没有别的

howto.what_en: Claude explains a codebase, folder, feature, command or pull request to a total beginner: first a one-sentence answer, then a PR Lens canvas whose views grow from two boxes to the whole picture, played in order. You get a view link.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /eli5 <thing>, or when asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or "like I'm five".

say_en.note: Builds a growing canvas and prints the view link

say_en.text: /eli5 explain this feature to a new hire
say_en.note: One sentence answer, then the picture grows

say_en.text: /eli5 explain this command like I'm five
say_en.note: Replies with the sentence and link only
